findings.defect: TAUTOLOGICAL. The harness itself writes cpu_nonce into c.txt at line 318-319, before the WorkUnit runs. The verifier therefore passes whether or not the unit did anything.
TAUTOLOGICAL. Same file, same pre-written nonce as cpu1.
Checks only that a compact report file exists and is non-empty. It never checks that the requested token was echoed, nor that the report belongs to this unit's task.

Same non-empty-file check. An independent audit found grok1 and grok2 resolved to the SAME Grok task id (consult-20260822-224557, a 1-second-resolution id collision from grok-run:210-218), so two WorkUnits were accepted off one Grok run and grok2's token was never in any prompt.

annualization.defect: A 12.4-second window extrapolated by ~291x into an hourly rate, from four units whose verifiers cannot fail. This number must not be reported as throughput.

consequence: The existing .hcli/max-equilibrium.json does not qualify anything. It cannot be used as the MAX baseline, and verified_units_per_hour=1164 must not be surfaced by /status.
what_a_real_campaign_requires: every WorkUnit maps to a real repository change or a real measurement, with the diff or receipt to prove it
no verifier whose subject is written by the harness before the unit runs
a Grok unit's verifier must bind to that unit's own task id and check the unit's own required output
throughput measured over a window long enough that annualization is not the dominant term
